label: TP
reason: User-supplied header name flows directly into bar via Base64 encode/decode round-trip, then constructs a file path via concatenation (fileName = TESTFILES_DIR + bar), which is passed to new File() and read by FileInputStream. The encoding/decoding preserves control characters and special sequences that enable path traversal or arbitrary file access, and there is no validation against allowed paths or directory separators. The sink writes the resulting filename to the HTTP response, exposing potential leakage or execution of unintended files.

evidence.note: header name -> param -> bar (via Base64 encode/decode) -> fileName -> new File() -> FileInputStream()
